children: former Whirlpool CFO brings finance, strategy and governance experience across consumer goods, manufacturing and healthcare sectors in India and overseas

Anil Berera has been appointed as an Independent Director on the board of Vodafone Idea, bringing more than two decades of experience in finance, business strategy, governance and advisory roles. His career spans senior finance positions across consumer goods, manufacturing and healthcare, along with experience in India and international markets.

Berera most recently served as a Strategic Advisor and Independent Director, following a career in senior corporate finance and advisory positions. His experience includes financial leadership, business planning, strategic decision-making and board-level responsibilities.

He spent more than 13 years with Whirlpool Corporation, where he held finance leadership positions across India and Asia. From October 2017 to December 2019, he served as Chief Financial Officer and Vice President, Asia, based in Hong Kong.

Before that, Berera was Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Asia South, from March 2008 to September 2017. He also served as Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, India, from 2007 to March 2008.

During his tenure at Whirlpool, Berera held responsibility for finance functions across multiple markets and progressed through senior leadership positions. His roles covered financial management and business operations in India and the wider Asia region.
The experience also included working in Hong Kong, giving him exposure to regional finance operations and international business environments.
Before joining Whirlpool, Berera served as Regional Finance Director at Gillette India from 2001 to 2006. Earlier, he was Director Finance at Becton Dickinson India from 1996 to 2001.
His career has therefore included finance leadership across consumer products, healthcare and manufacturing, with responsibilities spanning financial management and business operations.
Berera's recent work as a Strategic Advisor and Independent Director has added board and governance experience to his corporate finance background.

His appointment at Vodafone Idea brings together his experience in financial leadership, international markets, business strategy and board-level advisory responsibilities. The role adds another board position to a career that has moved from corporate finance into strategic and governance-focused assignments.
